name: Titan, Adonian
body:
TITAN, ADONIAN
CR 23

XP 819,200
LG Medium outsider (extraplanar, good, lawful, psionic)
Init +12; Senses darkvision 120 ft., pierce the veils; Perception +34

DEFENSE

AC 42 touch 34, flat-footed 34 (+16 deflection, +8 Dex, +8 natural)
hp 460 (23d10+334); regeneration 15 (chaotic)
Fort +27, Ref +16, Will +21; +11 resistance vs. mind-affecting

DR 15/chaotic Immune aging, death effects, disease; PR

OFFENSE

Speed 90 ft., fly 90 ft. (perfect)
Melee 2 slams +35 (6d10+14 plus cosmic blows)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 60 ft.
Special Attacks cosmic blows, psionic fist +2
Psi-Like Abilities (ML 20th; concentration +29)

Constant—adapt body, personal barred mind, pierce the veils, reddopsi (15 pp, replenishes at the start of the adonian’s turn)
At will—awestrike*, dispel psionics*, dispelling buffer, guide the willing*, suppress compulsion *
3/day—aura alteration*, cleanse spirit (eliminates conditions as if augmented), interplanetary psychoport, planar travel, remote viewing (DC 23, 40 ft.), sever the strand
1/day—apopsi (DC 28), gate of avernus*, metafaculty, psychic chirurgery, psychic reformation*, unravel psionics

STATISTICS

Str 34, Dex 27, Con 38, Int 19, Wis 27, Cha 29
Base Atk +23; CMB +53; b 71
Feats Combat Reflexes, Deep Focus, Greater Vital Strike, Greater Psionic Fist, Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Power Attack, Psionic Body, Psionic Fist, Psionic Meditation, Unavoidable Strike, Vital Strike
Skills Craft (mechanical) +30, Diplomacy +35, Intimidate +35, Knowledge (arcana) +30, Knowledge (engineering) +30, Knowledge (planes) +30, Knowledge (religion) +30, Perception +34, Sense Motive +34, Spellcraft +30
Languages telepathy 300 ft., truespeech
SQ astral avatar

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Astral Avatar (Su)

Although an adonian appears to be the size of a normal humanoid, it possesses a much larger body of force on the Astral Plane which it can pull into this universe momentarily.

This grants the adonian a +16 deflection bonus to AC and CMD and increases its reach to 60 feet. An adonian also gains a +16 bonus on combat maneuver checks and is treated as a colossal creature for the purpose of determining what creatures it may perform combat maneuvers against. An adonian in an area of a dimensional lock or similar effect which prevents planar travel loses this ability.

Cosmic Blows (Su)

An adonian’s slam attacks ignore all forms of damage reduction and hardness and is treated as epic for the purpose of overcoming regeneration.

In addition, any creature struck by an adonian’s slam attack must succeed at a DC 30 Will save or lose any spell resistance or immunity they possess for 1d4 rounds. The save DC is Charisma-based.

ABOUT

The only indicators of this mundane humanoid’s otherworldly power lie in the white markings across their body, images typically concealed by bandages and converging into vortex-like eyes. When an adonian titan reveals its true presence from the astral plane, the atmosphere seems to disintegrate around it, momentarily revealing a titanic outline which resembles nothing of their physical shape.
